description: Unique identifier of the source document in the corpus (DOC001-DOC050). Groups chunks belonging to the same document.
File format of the source document: PDF, Word, TXT, HTML or Markdown. Determines the loader/parser used during ingestion.
Unique identifier of a text chunk produced by splitting a document for embedding (CHK00001-CHK00500). Primary key.
Number of words in the chunk (range 50-499). Indicates chunk size used by the text splitter.
Similarity score (0-1) between the user query embedding and the chunk embedding returned by the vector store (ChromaDB). Higher means more relevant.
Category of the user question: factual, analytical, comparative, procedural or summarization.
Evaluation score (0-1) of the LLM-generated answer for the query using this chunk as context (faithfulness/relevance). Higher is better.
Engineered: 1 if word_count, retrieval_score or answer_quality_score lies outside 1.5xIQR, else 0.
Engineered: word_count bucket - short (<=150), medium (151-300), long (>300).
Engineered: retrieval_score bucket - low (<0.65), medium (0.65-0.80), high (>=0.80).
Engineered: answer_quality_score bucket - poor (<0.70), acceptable (0.70-0.85), good (>=0.85).
Engineered: 1 if retrieval_score >= 0.70 (chunk considered relevant), else 0.
Engineered: 1 if retrieval_score < 0.60 or answer_quality_score < 0.70; such answers should be shown with a hallucination warning.
